description.value: Tourism Sun Peaks is the visitor and member services office for Sun Peaks Resort, BC's second-largest four-season mountain resort. Located in the village, it serves as the central information hub for a resort spanning three mountains with an extensive bike park, hiking network, golf, and alpine skiing. Touring cyclists riding into the area can use it as a first stop for local trail conditions, event information, and resort orientation.

No amenity-specific evidence for this tourism office is present in the fetched content.
